issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event line 1 says B-24c3 bumped timeoutMs for 9 smokes, but Key Insights line 8 says the 13 known-race smokes have serial wall-times 9-129s. Two different counts of known-race smokes within the same document; a new reader cannot resolve the discrepancy.

CHK-003 context states the acceptance criterion as 162/162 (or 166/166) PASS with no explanation of why there are two possible totals or which applies. Makes the pass/fail criterion ambiguous to a new reader.
